17113.explanation: In Luke 9:59-60, when Jesus told the would-be disciple, "Let the dead bury their own dead, but you go and proclaim the kingdom of God," He was emphasising the urgency and priority of following Him. "The dead" in the first instance refers to the spiritually dead (those not following Christ). "Their own dead" refers to those who are physically dead. Jesus was urging the man to focus on the spiritual call rather than worldly obligations.

the spirittually dead should be left to bury the physically dead
the man's father had not died
there was an assurance of resurrection for all
